edges.reason: onlyOwner requires owner() == _msgSender(), so msg.sender controls access to the allowlist admin function
RenounceOwnership(address) is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender against _owner
owner-only function performs the privileged allowlist assignment _enable[user] = enable
owner-only function overwrites the privileged _uni destination
assignment writes the _enable mapping entry for user
assignment writes the _uni state variable
_beforeTokenTransfer reads _uni to decide whether the allowlist gate applies
_beforeTokenTransfer reads _enable[from] while checking the destination
hook executes the require(_enable[from]) allowlist gate
require expression reads the _enable mapping for the sender
cap check reads ERC20.totalSupply() and adds amount before minting
super._mint is invoked only after the supply cap arithmetic check passes
ERC20._mint performs the total supply increment
_totalSupply += amount updates the capped total supply
mint credits _balances[account] += amount
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount for the debit
_transfer computes the recipient credit
debit writes _balances[sender]
credit writes _balances[recipient]
constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply
constructor allowlists the initial holder in _enable
ERC20.transfer calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating the allowance
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()]
transferFrom calls _approve to store the reduced allowance
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
_transfer triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook (overridden by DONKEYKONG)
mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_burn debits _balances[account] - amount
_burn reduces _totalSupply by amount
owner() returns the _owner state variable
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner(), so the caller influences the authorization decision

parameter enable feeds DONKEYKONG.transfer(address,bool)
enable is written into the allowlist mapping

parameter uni_ feeds RenounceOwnership(address)
uni_ is assigned into the privileged _uni state variable
parameter account feeds DONKEYKONG._mint
parameter amount feeds the capped DONKEYKONG._mint
amount participates in the mint supply arithmetic

parameter from feeds DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer
parameter to feeds DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer
from is looked up in _enable by the allowlist require
currentAllowance is compared against amount and then subtracted
currentAllowance - amount is stored through _approve
senderBalance is read from _balances[sender] inside _transfer
senderBalance - amount is computed for the sender debit
accountBalance is read and reduced by amount in _burn

normalization_plan.reason: user is only a transient argument of the owner-only allowlist setter; it carries no independent semantics
enable is the value directly written into the privileged _enable mapping by the onlyOwner function
uni_ is immediately stored into the privileged _uni state variable and has no other use
account is only the recipient argument of the capped mint wrapper
amount is fed through the cap check into the mint arithmetic and does not exist independently
from is only used as the _enable lookup key inside the transfer hook
to is only compared against _uni inside the transfer hook
currentAllowance is a scratch variable that only exists for the allowance check and decrease
senderBalance is a scratch copy of the sender balance consumed by the debit arithmetic
accountBalance is a scratch copy of the burn source balance used only inside _burn
